description: Uncut's bundled sound effects (D134, D208): CC0 1.0 (public domain) sounds from Freesound and Kenney, each licence checked when the pack is made (the Freesound page's licence link, the Kenney pack's License.txt). Levelled to -20 LUFS integrated, sample peak at most -1 dBFS, AAC 112k. Made by scripts/make-sfx.ts.
